title: NZ Gym Membership Prices 2026 — Full Comparison of Every Major Chain
meta_desc: NZ gym membership prices 2026. Full price comparison for all major NZ gym chains — City Fitness, Jetts, Anytime Fitness, Les Mills, F45, Snap Fitness and more.
intro: Gym prices in New Zealand range from $7.99/week (City Fitness Basic) to $46/week (Orangetheory top tier). This guide covers the current prices at every major NZ gym chain, with joining fees, contract terms, and a clear breakdown of what you're actually getting for the money.

sections.heading: Budget Gyms (Under $15/week)
sections.body: City Fitness Basic at $7.99/week is the cheapest commercial gym membership in NZ. With 24/7 access and no long-term lock-in (just a 4-week minimum), it's excellent value. Contours ($9.99/week) is the best budget option for women wanting a supportive circuit format. Jetts ($14.95/week) has no joining fee and no lock-in — the best upfront value in the 24/7 category. ClassPass from $9/week provides access to multiple studio classes across participating venues.

sections.heading: Mid-Range Gyms ($15–$20/week)
sections.body: Snap Fitness ($14.95–$17.95/week) and Anytime Fitness ($16.95–$22.95/week) sit in the mid-range with 24/7 access and wider club networks than City Fitness. YMCA ($17.50–$26/week) provides the best community-focused option with pools and family programmes. Les Mills ($17.99–$29.99/week) is the premium group fitness chain — excellent class quality and the under-23 discount makes it competitive for younger members.

sections.heading: Premium and Boutique Gyms ($20+/week)
sections.body: Orangetheory ($18.25–$46.15/week), 9Round ($24.99–$34.99/week), and F45 ($25–$42.50/week) are the premium boutique options. They offer smaller class sizes, higher coaching intensity, and a strong community — but at a significant price premium. For members who've struggled to commit to cheaper options, the accountability and community of boutique studios can be worth the extra cost.

sections.heading: What Affects the Price You Pay
list: Joining fees — often waived during promotions; always ask before paying
Contract length — 12-month contracts lock in the rate but restrict flexibility
Club tier — same chain but different suburb can have different prices
Student/under-23 discounts — Les Mills 20% off, YMCA youth rates
Corporate rates — Anytime Fitness and Les Mills offer employer deals
Promotional periods — January and June often see lower joining fees or free months

sections.heading: Key Findings — NZ Gym Prices 2026
list: Cheapest 24/7 gym: City Fitness Basic at $7.99/week
Best no joining fee deal: Jetts at $14.95/week ($0 upfront)
Best value 24/7 multi-club: City Fitness Black Card at $14.99/week
Most expensive: F45 (up to $42.50/week) and Orangetheory (up to $46.15/week)
Best under-23 deal: Les Mills at $17.99/week less 20% = ~$14.40/week
Best for pool access: YMCA or selected Les Mills flagship clubs

faq.question: What is the cheapest gym in NZ?
faq.answer: City Fitness Basic is the cheapest gym in NZ at $7.99/week with 24/7 access and no long-term lock-in. Jetts is the cheapest with no joining fee at $14.95/week.

faq.question: How much does a gym membership cost in NZ per month?
faq.answer: Budget gyms cost $30–$65/month. Mid-range gyms $65–$90/month. Premium and boutique gyms $90–$200/month. The cheapest option is City Fitness Basic at approximately $35/month.

faq.question: Which NZ gym has no joining fee?
faq.answer: Jetts, Contours, ClassPass, 9Round, and F45 all have no joining fee. City Fitness and Les Mills joining fees ($29 and $49 respectively) are frequently waived during promotions.
